title: Here’s How to Watch ‘Descendants: Wicked Wonderland’ Online for Free
summary: Starring Kylie Cantrall and Malia Baker, the fifth Descendants film is available to stream.
contentText:

Red and Chloe are back together in Descendants: Wicked Wonderland , a new Disney Channel Original Movie. It promises time-traveling antics, breathtaking adventure, friendship, a little bit of romance and plenty of sing-along fun.

Descendants: Wicked Wonderland , the fifth entry in the series, is available to stream on Disney+ .

Watch on Disney+

Additionally, the other movies in the series — Descendants , Descendants 2 , Descendants 3 and Descendants: The Rise of Red — are streamable on Disney+ .

How to Watch ‘Descendants: Wicked Wonderland’ Online

Disney+ plans start at $7.99 per month for the ad-supported plan, while you can go ad-free for $13.99 per month. For even more content, Disney+ offers a bundle with Disney+ and Hulu, which starts at $9.99 per month. You can add ESPN Unlimited to Disney+ and Hulu starting at $35.99 per month.

Meanwhile, if you’re not into ESPN Unlimited, you can add HBO Max to Disney+ and Hulu instead with prices starting at $19.99 per month.

‘Descendants: Wicked Wonderland’; Synopsis & Cast

Directed by Kimmy Gatewood, Descendants: Wicked Wonderland follows Red (Kylie Cantrall) and Chloe (Malia Baker) discovering unintended consequences from traveling through time in Descendants: The Rise of Red . The villainous Maddox Hatter (Leonardo Nam) captures the Queen of Hearts (Rita Ora) during Auradon’s Kingdom Cup Games in Wonderland. The pair has to now team up again to save Wonderland and its queen.

The Disney movie also stars Liamani Segura, Brendon Tremblay, Alexandro Byrd, Kiara Romero, Melanie Paxson, Paolo Montalban, Joel Oulette, Zavien Garrett, Ryan McEwen, Dayton Paradis, Awkwafina, Brandy and others.
